# PixelGuard - Free Privacy-First Image Compressor & Resizer

> https://pixelguard.site

## Overview
PixelGuard is a fast, secure, and 100% client-side image compression and resizing tool. All processing happens in the browser - no uploads, no servers, no tracking.

## Key Features
- Compress images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF)
- Resize images with custom dimensions
- Batch processing support
- Privacy-first: files never leave your device
- Free to use
- No registration required

## Main Pages
- Homepage: https://pixelguard.site/ - Main image compression tool
- Privacy Policy: https://pixelguard.site/privacy-policy - Privacy practices
- Terms of Service: https://pixelguard.site/terms-of-service - Terms and conditions
- Contact Us: https://pixelguard.site/contact-us - Contact information

## Technology Stack
- Client-side processing using Web Workers
- Browser Image Compression API
- React + TypeScript
- No backend required

## Use Cases
- Optimize images for web
- Reduce file sizes for faster loading
- Prepare images for social media
- Batch resize photos
- Compress without quality loss
